description: Dataset to accompany paper: "Can battery deployment avoid network reinforcement in an unbundled electricity system? A Great Britain case study is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Susan Brush, Graeme Hawker (University of Strathclyde). This dataset accompanies manuscript entitled "Can battery deployment avoid network reinforcement in an unbundled electricity system? A Great Britain case study". The research is in the context of a recognised need for flexible resources on Great Britain (GB)'s electricity system, as greater penetrations of less flexible or inflexible generation are deployed to aid system decarbonisation. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
